Class ControllerExperience

java.lang.Object
guiExperience.ControllerExperience
public final class ControllerExperience extends Object

Title: ControllerExperience

Description: Handles history refresh, adding attempts, and selected-record details. Validation errors preserve form input; failed SQL writes are never reported as saved.
